A1.justification: Both PDFs describe the same AIM-CoT study. Their main text, Figures 1–6, Tables 1–21, equations, and Appendices A–M are available and comparable despite text reflow and relocated displays.

before.justification: v2 reports original AIM-CoT benchmark results, component ablations, robustness experiments, qualitative analyses, and inference-time measurements.

after.justification: v4 retains these original empirical results in the main text and appendices, including benchmark comparisons and deployment measurements.

M1.justification: Section 4 and Algorithm 1 retain the same CAG, information-gain-based AVP, and DAT procedures. The adaptive Z-score trigger, negative constraints, and insertion safety instructions were already present in v2.

E1.justification: Both versions evaluate M3CoT, ScienceQA, and LLaVA-W and retain the same masking, noise-injection, and qualitative test scenarios. The added diffusion-model discussion concerns cited research, not newly evaluated coverage.

E2.justification: Table 1 retains No-CoT, DDCoT, MMCoT, CCoT, SCAFFOLD, and ICoT. Comparator membership in the appendix experiments is also unchanged. Newly cited in-context learning and diffusion methods are not added to the evaluated comparisons.

E3.justification: The four backbones, zero-/one-shot settings, metrics, sample sizes, and experimental procedures remain unchanged. Appendix A.2 merely identifies the previously described one-shot example as in-context learning; it does not revise that protocol.

E4.justification: The component and interplay ablations, threshold and candidate-size sensitivity studies, attention-noise and safeguard tests, source-distribution and submodularity analyses, and qualitative cases all appear in both versions with unchanged evidence.

E5.justification: Both retain the same McNemar and Wilcoxon testing, correlation and t-test analyses, binomial tests, and three repetitions of the source-distribution experiment. v4 adds no run-count, seed, or uncertainty-reporting information.

E6.justification: Matched numerical and qualitative results are unchanged throughout the paper. For example, Table 1 retains Chameleon-7B zero-shot AIM-CoT scores of 31.4 on M3CoT, 53.1 on ScienceQA, and 29.8 on LLaVA-W; appendix robustness and timing results also match.

T1.justification: The entropy and information-gain definitions, attention-shift and adaptive-trigger equations, submodularity argument in Appendix I.4, and complexity derivations in Appendix M.1 are unchanged. Additional citations introduce no new mathematical assumptions or proofs.

C1.justification: The abstract, introduction, and conclusion retain the same contributions: active evidence selection, dynamic insertion, the three-component framework, and consistent superiority across three benchmarks and four backbones. The novelty and contribution scope are not revised.

C2.justification: Interpretations of attention reliability, module synergy, backbone-dependent gains, threshold tradeoffs, and noise-related failures remain unchanged. Appendix I.3 adds only a general statement that unsupervised noise rejection is desirable, without a new substantive interpretation or limitation.

D1.justification: Table 7's hyperparameters, the CAG prompt, Appendix M's implementation information about batching and KV caching, and the reported code-access address remain unchanged. No additional reproducibility instructions or implementation settings are disclosed.

R1.justification: v4 adds ten references covering reasoning failures, uncertainty quantification, video retrieval, noise detection, in-context learning, and diffusion acceleration. These receive brief contextual links in the text and appendices; the central positioning against ICoT remains unchanged.

P1.justification: v4 adds short contextual clauses and sentences, notably in Appendices A.2, B, and I.3, alongside citation edits. The section hierarchy and overall narrative remain intact. Section 3.2 newly contains an unresolved '?' citation.

P2.justification: Text reflow relocates existing displays: Table 7 moves between columns on PDF page 13, Figure 4 moves from page 15 to 16, and Table 21 moves from page 29 to 30. Figure artwork, captions, and table structures remain unchanged.

improvement.justification: The added references modestly broaden context, but v4 introduces an unresolved '?' citation in Section 3.2. Appendix B also inserts a diffusion-efficiency aside between the general VLM definition and Equation 7, weakening that explanation's continuity. These are limited losses in citation traceability and clarity; the scientific evidence and reproducibility information remain unchanged.
